text: とは　いっても　てもちが　いっぱいの　ようだね　また　こんど　おいで

structure.jp: てもちが　いっぱいの　ようだね
structure.en: your party seems to be full

structure.jp: また　こんど　おいで

patterns.name: 〜とはいっても
patterns.explanation: とは いっても is a set phrase, 'even though I say that', used to take back a little of what was just said. とは いっても = 'that said'.

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.span: いっぱいの　ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ says how things look to the speaker: 'it seems'. いっぱいの ようだ = 'it seems to be full'.
